'''Director of Sienar Marketing Relations''' was an employment title at [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], a major [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer. It was held by [[Taed Augustus]] during the unveiling of the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]<ref name="TIE" /> in the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFUIIc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Director of Sienar Marketing Relations was first mentioned in the "TIE Advanced" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.<ref name="TIE" />
